breakdown.description: The prompt collapses the distributed self-weight into a single end load and calls it exact, even though the axial force from self-weight varies continuously along the bar.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly uses the integration approach P(x) = ρ g A (L - x) with δ = ∫₀ᴸ P(x)/(A E) dx, treating the self-weight as a continuously varying distributed load. There is no mention of replacing the distributed self-weight with a single concentrated end load or calling such an approximation 'exact.' This matches the ground truth prompt's approach.
